actual_controls: Explicit NI010 predecessor downgrade, legacy row insertion at that schema, upgrade to exact routed head, downgrade and finally current-head restoration.

Legacy raw JSON text preserves signed zero, integer beyond IEEE754 exact range, Unicode and JSON null; record bytes/digests/sizes, cursor managed state, completion identity and timestamps remain unchanged. Added defaults are PAYLOAD and LEGACY, with no graph or receipt binding.
A metadata-only DAG survives an allowed NI010 schema roundtrip without losing graph digest, subtask count or restored read-plan identity.

Actual reflected composite FK column order, referenced columns, RESTRICT pins and named checks match the reviewed contract on both backends; exactly one FK in the routed tables is deferred: receipt input REFERENCE.

Direct DDL fixtures seed four operators A→B→C→D, four PAYLOADs, three direct REFERENCEs, four valid wire outcomes and three stable subscribers/completions. No routing mutation service or execution bypass is called.
Foreign-flow/partition mismatch, payload digest, receipt/payload, edge partition, subscriber/port, input-port and completion-intent corruption reject and preserve baseline rows.
REFERENCE links and receipt outputs cannot be relabelled as REFERENCE chains.
Deleting or rebinding an input REFERENCE flushes but cannot commit; a marker write and all changes roll back at the actual deferred FK failure.
Output PAYLOAD and input PAYLOAD pins reject DELETE immediately, while only the input REFERENCE link is deferred.
Whole-Flow-locked deletion of REFERENCEs, completions, receipts, consumers, then PAYLOADs commits across all three hops; an injected transaction rollback restores the complete baseline.
Downgrade refuses full routed history, a graph-bound payload and an acknowledged subscriber retained after payload horizon cleanup; each expected refusal finally restores head and preserves rows.

history.qualification: The first draft had unused imports reserved for unfinished sections; no failing database attempt occurred. Both first fixture executions and the completed suite are preserved.

reproduction.selectors: Run the full file on each backend; all 23 cases execute without dialect skips.

source_binding.qualification: Executed test bytes were copied before running. Current participating source copies match both pre-run and post-run hashes.
